Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

-a I

  • Meaning: "my" (1 sg. pron. suff.)
  • Lines: 20, 53, 98, 140, 181
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-a%20I

alādu I

  • Meaning: "to give birth (to)" [Ù.TU; occas. TU]
    • G: (a/i)
    • Gtn: iter. of G [Ù.TU.MEŠ]
    • Dt: pass. of D "be begotten"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: pass. of G children mala waldū u iwwalladū "as many as are or shall be born"
  • Logograms: Ù.TU, TU, Ù.TU.MEŠ
  • Lines: 26, 107, 210, 213
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81du%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 3, 36, 81, a+5', 122, 165, 215, 216
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

ammīni I

  • Meaning: "why?";
  • Lines: 18, 19, 20, 51, 52, 53, 96, 97, 98, 138, 139, 140, 179, 180, 181
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/amm%C4%ABni%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 9, 21, 22, 30, 33, 42, 54, 55, 78, 87, 99, 100, 129, 141, 142, 162, 170, 182, 183, b+3'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 17, 27, 32, 34, 35, 37, 38, 41, 43, 50, 79, 80, 82, 83, 86, 88, 95, 106, 108, a+3', a+4', 120, 121, 124, 125, 128, 130, 137, 163, 164, 166, 169, 171, 178, 211, 214, 217, 219
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

annû I

  • Meaning: OB occas. with nunation "this, those" [j/NB NE; ŠEŠ (for m. pl. annûti)]; OB f. sg. annītum "this matter"; annītam lā annītam 'this one, not this one', "one way or another"; a. ū a. "various"; NA a(n)nûte ... a(n)nûte ... "some ..., others ..."; (a)kī (h)anni(ma) "thus, in the same way";
  • Logograms: ,
  • Lines: 156
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ann%C3%BB%20I

anāku I

  • Meaning: "I; me" [Bogh. GÁ.E] as pred. freq. anākuma; OB ša anāku "as for me"; NB also acc. (to stress a pron. suff.), dat.
  • Logograms: GÁ.E
  • Lines: b+7'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81ku%20I

arāku I

  • Meaning: "to be long" [GÍD(.DA)]
    • G: (i/i) of distance; transf. in PN of arm (idum); of time, patience, life, reign "be long, last long; drag on; be too long"
    • D: of space, time "make long, lengthen; be overdue"; in hendiad. urruku + vb. "do X at length"
    • Dt: "be protracted"
    • Š: "prolong, extend" time
  • Logograms: GÍD GÍD.DA
  • Lines: 71
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ar%C4%81ku%20I

awû I

  • Meaning: "to speak"
    • G: (pret. īwu; stat. and 2 pers. sg. imper. awu) OA only
    • Gtn: iter. OA
    • Gt: (atwûm, later atmû) "speak" OA; O/jB(lit.) "discuss"; išti/itti X a. "negotiate with X"; ana X a. "tell X, speak to X"; OA "order (to do s.th.)"; jB itti libbīya (etc.) a. "think about" s.th.
  • Lines: 17, 50, 95, 137, 178
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C3%BB%20I

awātu I

  • Meaning: "word; matter" [INIM]
  • Logograms: INIM
  • Lines: 9, 33, 42, 78, 87, 129, 162, 170
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/aw%C4%81tu%20I

ašru III

  • Meaning: pl. m. & f., "place, site" [KI]
  • Logograms: KI
  • Lines: a+6'
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%C5%A1ru%20III

aṣû I

  • Meaning: "to go out", + vent. "come out" (from = ina, ištu, acc.)
    • G: (perf. ittaṣi, NA ittūṣi) [È; MB in PNs also UD]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [È.MEŠ]
    • Gt: separative of G "go away (for good)"
    • Š: Mari
    • Štn: pass. of Š
    • Št2: "quarrel, pick a fight"
  • Logograms: È, UD, È.MEŠ
  • Lines: 102
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/a%E1%B9%A3%C3%BB%20I

banû II

  • Meaning: "to be(come) good, beautiful" Bab.
    • G: (i/i) [NB in PN DÙ] of person, object, word, deed etc.
    • D: "make good, beautify" person, animal, object, building etc.; "look after s.o. kindly, respectfully"; NB "produce s.th. well", NB (+ tabnītu) "execute well, do a good job"
  • Logograms:
  • Lines: 28, 109, 155
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ban%C3%BB%20II

barāqu I

  • Meaning: "to lighten, shine" Bab.(lit.)
    • G: (i/i) [HI.HI] berqu + b. "lightning strikes"; of Adad "strike s.th. with lightning"; of eyes "flash"
    • D: jB stat. of woman "has flashing eyes?"
    • Štn: NB iter. of Š 2
    • Ntn: jB "flash, light up repeatedly", MB ptcp. ^d^Muttabriqu as name of demon
  • Logograms: HI.HI
  • Lines: 103
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bar%C4%81qu%20I

belû II

  • Meaning: "to be extinguished, come to an end" O/jB, NA
    • G: (i/i) of fire, smoke; of oil-bubble "burst"; transf. of life, disease etc.
    • Gtn: iter., of brazier, torch
    • D: "extinguish" fire, disease, fever; "stop" quarrel, fight; "destroy" people, life etc.
  • Lines: 105
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/bel%C3%BB%20II

berqu I

  • Meaning: "lightning (flash)" M/jB, NA [NIM.GÍR]; also "(symbol of) lightning";
  • Logograms: NIM.GÍR
  • Lines: 103
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/berqu%20I

bābu I

  • Meaning: pl. m. & f. "gate, door" [KÁ]
  • Logograms: KÁ, ME.NI

bītu I

  • Meaning: m.; pl. f. bītātu(m), Ass. also m., M/NA bētānu "house" [É; pl. É.MEŠ, also É.HI.A(.MEŠ); OB(Susa) É.A.NI]
  • Logograms: É, É.MEŠ, É.HI.A(.MEŠ), É.A.NI
  • Lines: 10, 43, 88, 130, 171
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/b%C4%ABtu%20I

būru I

  • Lines: 5, 38, 83, 125, 166

  • Logograms: GIŠ/GI.IG

damqu I

  • Meaning: "good" [SIG5]
  • Logograms: SIG5, A/DUMU.SIG/SIG5, SIG5-, MUNUS.SIG5

  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/damqu%20I

damāqu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) good"
    • G: (i/i; NA stat. de'iq, dêq) [SIG5; stat. also AL.SA6]
    • D: [SIG5]
    • Dtn: OB "continually make good"
    • Š: jB "make" omen etc. "propitious"
  • Logograms: SIG5, AL.SA6, KAL
  • Lines: 28
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/dam%C4%81qu%20I

ekletu I

  • Meaning: (or iklētu(m)) "darkness" Bab. [KÚKKU]; bīt e. "dark chamber", "underworld";
  • Logograms: KÚKKU
  • Lines: 102
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ekletu%20I

eli I

  • Meaning: "on, over, above; against; more than" OAkk, Bab., rarely NA [UGU] "on; on to" a place, a thing; of obligation etc. "on; on to" a person; of person "over" another, a task; "in addition to"; "more than" in quantity or quality; "against" enemy, person, esp. of anger, shout; "on account, on behalf of" s.o.; "to" s.o. after ṭiābu(m), marāṣu(m) "to please, displease";
  • Logograms: UGU
  • Lines: 15, 48, 93, 135, 158, 161, 176
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/eli%20I

elû III

  • Meaning: "to go up, arise; (stat.) is high"
    • G: (i/i) [E11; jB also AN.TA]
    • Gtn: iter.
    • Gt: "go up and away"; of person, animal, silver, illness; O/jB ina X e. "forfeit X"
    • D: "make higher, raise" wall, building, 'head' (rēšu) of building; of deity "lift up, elevate" person, kingship (also with rēšu); "extol, praise (deity)"; NA "take away, remove"
    • Dtn: "repeatedly extol"
    • Š: [E11] caus. of G; jB ana zaqīpi š. "impale"; "post, install" garrison in fort etc.; Susa mê š. "have water close over one, be submerged" (in ordeal); "dedicate" to temple; "get out" from storage, kiln; "embark" person, goods; "bring forward" witnesses; "produce" lesion; "bring out, produce" tablet, lost property; "enter" on tablet; "introduce" bees to a region; "express" anxiety, thought; šum X š. "swear oath by X"; "disinherit" heir, "turn off, drive from" fields, land; "take" sheep from fold; "remove" boundary stone etc.; math. "subtract" [E11; NIM], "determine" root; Am. ša dama šūlû (desig. of gold)
    • Štn: iter. of Š
    • Št: jB of features in liver "be raised (as) high" as (= ana); Am. transf. of dowry "be made (as) immense as"
    • N: cf. ne'ellû
  • Logograms: E11,
  • Lines: 7, 40, 85, 127, 168
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/el%C3%BB%20III

emēdu I

  • Meaning: "to lean on; impose"
    • G: (OA, early OB a/u, later i/i) [UŠ]
    • Gtn: iter. MB "push ever further" into woods
    • Gt: OAkk "lie on each other"
    • D: "install" beams etc.; med. "apply" dressing; qāta(m) u. "lay hands on", liter. and transf. of legal act; "dock" a ship; "build" quay "onto" bank; "set" fire to s.th.; "hide (intrans.) in" corners; stat. "is in contact with"; OA "assemble, load" goods etc.
    • Dt: pass. of D with qātu
    • Š: caus. of G OAkk "cause to take refuge"; NB "cause to impose" tax
    • Št: "bring" troops etc. "together", "put" (o.'s heads) "together"; "add up" amounts; "knit" o.'s eyebrows; of parts of body, of liver; med. "mix", "add" ingredients "to one another"
    • Ntn: ?) "continually join together", astr. "continually conjoin"
  • Logograms: UŠ
  • Lines: 14, 47, 92, 134, 175
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/em%C4%93du%20I

Enkidu I

  • Meaning: —
  • Lines: 10, 27, 43, 88, 108, 130, 171, 211, 214, 217
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/Enkidu%20I

epēšu II

  • Meaning: "to do; make; build"
    • G: (e/u, later Bab. u/u) [DÙ; occas. AK, GI]
    • Gtn: iter.
    • Gt: "do thoroughly"?
    • D: OB "calculate" amount; "do up" hair; "treat, behave towards" s.o.; (in col.) "execute properly" tablet; Ass. often ~ G "practise" sorcery, "exercise" kingship etc., "conclude" agreement, "perform" prayer, "sacrifice" sheep, "operate" ferry, "work" gold; M/NA leg. in sale "carry out procedure"?
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "be active, work on" s.th.; of demons "work against" s.o. (= acc. or dat.)
    • N: (OB mostly inneppeš, ittenpeš, innepiš, later Bab. u/u) pass. of G šiprum (ul) inneppe/uš "can(not) be done"; of person "be treated"; of document "be drawn up"
  • Logograms: DÙ,
  • Lines: 10, 43, 88, 130, 171, 211, 214, 217
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ep%C4%93%C5%A1u%20II

etēqu I

  • Meaning: "to go past; go through; cross over"
    • G: (i/i, Mari pret. also ītuq) [DIB]
    • Gtn: iter. [DIB.MEŠ], e.g. of sun "constantly pass across" heaven
    • Gt: OA "proceed further onwards"
    • Š: caus. of G [DIB] "channel" water-flow; "pass" ship through control; OB stat. of slave "is made to step over" pestle; NA "carry out" ritual (takpertu), also ellipt.; "send, carry past" in parade; NB "make s.o. pass on (empty-handed)"; "make" evil, bad luck, illness "pass on, pass by"; "allow" time "to go past", "miss time for" offering, also ellipt. "miss (date)"; of sun "miss" eclipse; "make transcend, exceed" in quality, rank, size etc.
